headlines.A: Element has a solid night, gets by Appetite to grab the A crown; Beach cruises, easily locks in a top-4-in-RDL spot
headlines.B: Serious methodically pulls away the Kids to clinch B title; Possee wins, but not by enough to climb up into 2nd
headlines.C: Area sweeps two sets from Menace, coasts to 14-0 season; Secrets squeeze by Projectile in 1001 to lock down 2nd
headlines.D: Shorthanded Rally thumps Sanchez in match of D leaders; Knights fall to Stumble in what maybe looked like an inconsequential match, but it kept Stumble out of the bottom-2
headlines.E: What's the Point rolls big; Corks come from behind on Off Constantly to lock in 2nd place ahead of the Blanks
headlines.F: Two Time takes out Down to F in 1001, opening the door to the F title for Death Throw; but then Death Throw falls to Nein Mark!; and the idle Cheap Shots hop up to the #2 slot
headlines.G: Banging takes out Rippin in head-to-head title fight; Machine posts monster win, almost reels in the 2nd place spot
headlines.H: Sofa sweeps 501 to extend Vision's losing streak to four; but Dirty misses chance to steal 2nd, falling to the Rangers
